استكرهت (form X)

# اِسْتَكْرَهْتَ (istakrahta) /is.tak.rah.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اِسْتَكْرَهْتِ (istakrahti) /is.tak.rah.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اِسْتَكْرَهَتْ (istakrahat) /is.t
